[LSER.8.5.1] A series takes one sample of its tracked slot per fact that
enters working memory. A meaningful change to any of a fact's slots is a new
fact ([LFAC.2.5.3]), so it adds a sample whether or not the tracked slot
changed. A no-op reassertion adds none, because the engine suppresses it
([LFAC.2.5.1]). An author who wants a sample only when the tracked value
changes declares that slot in a schema of its own.
